MEET OUR OWNER, ZACH STIMPSON

Competition shaped the drive. Relationships shaped the business.

Being raised in North Carolina and being heavily involved in motorsports, I have developed a passion for going fast and winning. I enjoy competition, whether it’s on the track or at the negotiation table and take pride in getting things done, regardless of the location.

I moved to Idaho in 2018 to pursue an opportunity for growth inside the real estate industry... I ended up falling in love with not only the state, but the lady who would turn into my wife as well. I have always been an enthusiast of the great outdoors and feel the expanse of what this area has to offer is unrivaled by way of both the people and the landscape.

This has allowed me to expand upon my passion for financial freedom and develop an even greater passion for real estate and serving the folks of East Idaho. I absolutely love being able to create opportunities for people through homeownership. I truly believe there is nothing more impactful to one’s financial freedom journey than real estate, if navigated properly. It would be a pleasure to guide you down that path.

Zach Stimpson
REALTOR®
